candidates.reason: Native enlargement depicts one continuous northern island with a western hook. Modern reference has a detached western islet beside the larger island. A new centroid for the main modern island would require inventing a source division. Original hand point is also near the northern engraved shore. Exclusion is for definition uncertainty, not its relatively small 107.55 m affine discrepancy.

Broad view contains repeated tributary junctions, estuary braids and road crossings. Exact persistent bank/centreline correspondence was not established; the guide is not substituted for identity evidence.

Mullach Brook is a separate drainage. Around the Skye/Indian River confluence, road/bridge and river ink merge; current bank junction cannot be placed precisely in the inspected historic engraving. Avoid the same downstream road-junction error found at I10.
